title: PBA: TNT overwhelms Magnolia to take Game 1 of q'finals series
summary: The TNT Tropang 5G claimed a dominant win in Game 1 of their quarterfinals series, overpowering Magnolia 92-70 on Sunday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
